about: What an expedition carries and uses: tools, light, kit, clothing, containers. A professional's tool (tool: thieves' tools, a holy symbol) helps one trained in its skill at its checks and lends the untrained nothing; an ordinary thing's direct use (aids: a shovel, pitons, a ladder) meets a need of its skill for whoever carries it and helps a little at its checks. Neither is training: only magic grants a skill (grants.skill), as if its bearer had learnt it (the owner, 7 November).
